report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy: gateway and order show error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, zero db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts, and logs show only 200/ok. This contradicts the degraded-checkout alert and supports no public cause. No bounded root cause can be established, so hand off for evidence of the actual degradation.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing the actual degraded checkout signal (error rate, latency, or saturation) aligned to the alert window
Per-service latency/error breakdown for checkout path dependencies to localize the fault
Dependency timeout and db_pool_waiter data during the degraded period
Logs with non-200 statuses or error-level events during the alert window
